passes.scope: the 7 rows without ok; nothing else in the town was re-checked
passes.how: Google Maps opened in headless Chromium (2026-11-23), limited view without a reviews tab, so no review date could be read; each row searched with its Chinese name (zh) and/or its English name and the town. Maps' coverage of mainland China is thin: many listings carry no hours at all. A list result's hours line ('Open · Closes 10 PM', or 'Open now', which Maps shows only when it holds the place's hours) counted as a current listing. Where Maps could not settle a row, one web search (snippets only, pages not opened) was made for it.
